posture: Proofs gate withdrawals from a shared pool. The Merkle membership check does not bind the spent note to the leaf, so any prover can withdraw. The run stopped at its budget before the targeted wave, so the coverage below is partial. The single most important action is to hash the note into the leaf and bind Index into the path.
out_of_scope: Verifier.sol internals: a stub, not a generated verifier

hardening.title: Unused helper returns unconstrained hint outputs
hardening.detail: decompose is never called; delete it or constrain its outputs.

hardening.title: No test checks the public-input order against Pool.withdraw

accepted_risks.risk: The sequencer orders withdrawals and can delay them.

records.title: Remainder hint output is never constrained
records.description: The prover sets the divHint remainder to any value.
records.proof: Override divHint to return (q, r) = (1, 12345); Solve still succeeds because res[1] is unused.
records.impact: No direct impact today; any later use of res[1] is forgeable.

records.title: Merkle leaf is not bound to the spent note
records.description: Any prover proves membership of any existing leaf with a fresh Secret and withdraws any value.
records.proof: Take any known leaf and its siblings; set Secret=1, Index=7, In.Value=Out.Value=10^18; the witness satisfies every constraint.

gates.executes: Path[0] is not tied to In or Secret

fix.summary: Hash the note and Index into the leaf and select siblings by the Index bits.

+	h.Reset()

+	cur := h.Sum()
+	api.AssertIsEqual(cur, c.Path[0])

options.label: use std/accumulator/merkle
options.diff:

+	proof.VerifyProof(api, &h, c.Index)

refuter.reasoning: circuit/transfer.go:52 starts from Path[0]; nothing ties it to In or Secret.

records.title: Owner check is skipped when Index is non-zero
records.description: Any prover sets Index to 1 so flag is 0 and the owner equality holds trivially.
records.proof: Index=1 → flag=0 → 0·(In.Owner − Out.Owner) = 0 for any owners.
records.impact: Any prover moves a note to a new owner.

fix.summary: Assert In.Owner == Out.Owner unconditionally, or derive the gate from a constrained bit.

refuter.reasoning: Out.Owner is not used by Pool.withdraw, so ownership has no on-chain effect.
